questions.q: 11. In a certain code language, "PAGES" is coded as "192", "ABOVE" is coded as "180". What is the code for "PRIOR" in that code language ?
questions.s:
11.(a) Logic: (Sum of place value of letter) × 4 = given number
PAGES :- (16 + 1 + 7 + 5 + 19) × 4 ⇒ (48) × 4 = 192
ABOVE :- (1 + 2 + 15 +22 + 5) × 4 ⇒ (45) × 4 = 180
Similarly,
PRIOR :- (16 + 18 + 9 + 15 + 18) × 4 ⇒ (76) × 4 = 304

questions.q: If in the same language “Human success” is coded as “hi si”, then what is the code for human?
questions.s:
Reference:

In a certain language,

“Hardwork key to success” is coded as “vi uo si la”

“Student o hardwork” is coded as “ti li la”

“Student study to success” is coded as “si uo li fis”

“Hardwork to do study” is coded as “la uo fis ti”.

Inference:

Hardwork key to success – vi uo si la …….. (1)

Student do hardwork – ti li la …….. (2)

Student study to success – si uo li fis …….. (3)

Hardwork to do study – la uo fis it …….. (4)

From equation (1) and (2), we get:

Hardwork – la …….. (5)

From equation (1), (3) and (4), we get:

To – uo …….. (6)

From equation(1), (3) and (6), we get:

Success – si …….. (7)

Now in equation (1), key is only left whose code become vi.

From equation (2) and (3), we get:

Student – li …….. (8)

Now is equation (2), we get:

Do – ti …….. (9)

Now in equation (3), we get:

Study – fis ……… (10)

The code for success is ‘si’. Hence code for human becomes ‘hi’.

0402060205 means 'Ajit is father of Varun' and 0502110206 means 'Geeta is grandmother of Karuna'

The words are replaced by the total number of letters present in it.

If the letters present in the word is a single digit number, then 0 is written before it and if the letters present in the word is a double digit number, then it is written as it is.

questions_hin.q_hi:
In a certain code language, 0402060205 means 'Ajit is father of Varun' and 0502110206 means 'Geeta is grandmother of Karuna'. Which of the following is the code for 'Girish is cousin of Pournima'?

एक निश्चित कोड भाषा में 0402060205 का अर्थ 'Ajit is father of Varun' है और 0502110206 का अर्थ 'Geeta is grandmother of Karuna' है, तो निम्नलिखित में से कौन-सा विकल्प 'Girish is cousin of Pournima' का कोड है?
questions_hin.s_hi:
0402060205 means 'Ajit is father of Varun' and 0502110206 means 'Geeta is grandmother of Karuna'

Thus, the pattern is:

The words are replaced by the total number of letters present in it.

If the letters present in the word is a single digit number, then 0 is written before it and if the letters present in the word is a double digit number, then it is written as it is.

Example: Ajit = 04 and grandmother = 11

So, Girish is cousin of Pournima= 0602060208

questions_hin.q_hi: 4. एक निश्चित कूट भाषा में, "toys are gadgets" को "dj sq ty" के रूप में कूटबद्ध किया जाता है और "gadgets are machines" को "mp ty dj" के रूप में कूटबद्ध किया जाता है। उस भाषा में "gadgets" के लिए संभावित कूट क्या है?
questions_hin.s_hi:
4.(b) ‘toys are gadgets’ → ‘dj sq ty’ …….. (i)
‘gadgets are machines’ → ‘mp ty dj’ …….. (ii)
समीकरण (i) और (ii) में ‘are gadgets’ उभयनिष्ठ हैं और कोड (dj, ty) भी उभयनिष्ठ हैं।
तो, ‘gadgets’ का कोड या तो ‘ty’ या ‘dj’ " है।
